# Commands

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-commands-doc from the commandlines' declarations: edit those, not this. -->

Every commandline, as the app declares it. In the app, `?` (or `F1`), then the Commands tab, lists
the same. The language is the same everywhere: `key:value`, `|` between commands, a command's
arguments after it in any order, `-key:value` to take one off and `-key` to clear (where a
command has them), `"…"` or `\|` for a value with a `|` in it. Places: the value is what, `n:` is
where (`cover:3 n:1`).

An argument (↳) goes after its command, in any order with the others.

## Searching and filtering

A list's filter (/), the palette, the phone's search: every key goes with every other, no | needed. A key can be typed by any start of its names (two letters at least).

| Key | Other names | Takes | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `artist:` | `artists:` `by:` | text | by an artist |
| `featuring:` | `feat:` `ft:` | text | with an artist featured |
| `album:` | `on:` | text | on an album |
| `title:` | `name:` | text | its title |
| `year:` | `released:` `date:` | text | from a year |
| `genre:` | `genres:` | text | a genre |
| `status:` |  | text | released, demo… |
| `format:` | `codec:` | text | flac, mp3, lossless… |
| `flag:` | `missing:` `issue:` | text | a review flag on it |
| `kind:` | `type:` | text | album, ep, single… |
| `disc:` | `disk:` `cd:` | text | its disc |
| `track:` | `number:` `numbers:` `no:` `renumber:` | text | its track number |
| `group:` | `grouping:` `collective:` | text | in a grouping |
| `source:` | `sources:` `platform:` `from:` | text | a platform it has a source on |
| `og:` | `original:` | text, or nothing | original files (og:no the rest; words: in their names) |
| `bitrate:` | `kbps:` | text | its bitrate in kbps: <192, >=320, 128 |
| `rate:` | `samplerate:` `hz:` | text | its sample rate: 44.1k, >48k |

## The command palette

Ctrl+K: the search's keys (above), and these.

| Key | Other names | Takes | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `go:` | `goto:` | text | go to a page |
| `do:` | `run:` | text | run a command |

## The track editor

A track's page in edit mode, Review, Ctrl+E on a list.

| Key | Other names | Takes | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `title:` | `name:` | text | its title (any start of its names) |
| `artist:` `-artist:` `-artist` | `artists:` `by:` | an artist | credit one, or change one's name or place (-artist:Name takes one off; -artist: all) (any start of its names) |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;↳ `role:` |  | text | its role: primary, featured, producer… (another role: a credit of its own) (after -artist: too) |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;↳ `as:` |  | own, or one of the artist's names | the name it's credited under |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;↳ `n:` |  | a place: 2, 2-5 (disc 2, track 5), 1+ (in order from 1) | its place among the artists |
| `feat:` `-feat:` | `featuring:` `ft:` `featured:` | an artist | credit one as featured (any start of its names) |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;↳ `role:` |  | text | its role: primary, featured, producer… (another role: a credit of its own) (after -feat: too) |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;↳ `as:` |  | own, or one of the artist's names | the name it's credited under |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;↳ `n:` |  | a place: 2, 2-5 (disc 2, track 5), 1+ (in order from 1) | its place among the artists |
| `album:` `-album:` `-album` | `on:` | an album | on it as well (n: its numbers; -album:X off one; -album: all) (any start of its names) |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;↳ `n:` |  | a place: 2, 2-5 (disc 2, track 5), 1+ (in order from 1) | its numbers: 5, 2-5 (disc 2, track 5), or 1+ (in order from 1) |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;↳ `kind:` |  | text | a new album's kind: album, ep, single… |
| `date:` `-date:` `-date` | `year:` `released:` | text | released, as the source wrote it (none: no date) (any start of its names) |
| `genre:` `-genre:` `-genre` | `genres:` | text | genres to add, by commas (-genre:x takes one off; -genre: all) (any start of its names) |
| `status:` |  | text | released, demo… (any start of its names) |
| `flag:` `-flag:` | `missing:` `issue:` | text | a flag raised by hand (-flag:x settles that kind) (any start of its names) |
| `disc:` | `disk:` `cd:` | a number | its disc on the album (any start of its names) |
| `track:` | `number:` `numbers:` `no:` `renumber:` | text | its track number on the album (N+: in order from N) (any start of its names) |
| `group:` `-group:` | `grouping:` | a grouping | into a grouping, or a new one (kind:) (any start of its names) |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;↳ `kind:` |  | text | a new grouping's kind: collective, era, project… |
| `comment:` `-comment:` |  | text | its comment (none: no comment) |
| `related:` `-related:` `-related` | `relation:` | a track | a related track (-related:X takes one off; -related: all) |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;↳ `kind:` |  | text | how: a remix of it, an instrumental… |
| `cover:` `-cover:` `-cover` | `covers:` | text | paste, file, another album's or track's (n: where it goes); a number: that one moved (-cover:N to the trash; -cover: all) |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;↳ `n:` |  | a place: 2, 2-5 (disc 2, track 5), 1+ (in order from 1) | where it goes (1: the main one) |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;↳ `which:` |  | a number | which of that album's or track's covers |
| `source:` `-source:` `-source` | `sources:` | text | a link, a platform and its fields, or custom; = its only one; a number: correct that one (-source:N to the trash) (then its platform's fields (name:value)) |
| `origin:` |  | a number | the file came from its Nth source |
| `suffix:` `-suffix:` |  | text | added to the end of the title (-suffix:x takes from the last x on off; alone: put back) |
| `parse:` |  | text | the credits in the title, by the rules typed (feat prod…) |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;↳ `split:` |  | text | split names at these too |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;↳ `whole:` |  | on, off | names that are an artist's kept whole |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;↳ `keep:` |  | text | words kept in the title |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;↳ `word:` |  | text | a word that credits: "beat by"=prod |
| `single:` |  | nothing | a single of its own, for each |
| `along:` |  | on, off | albums it's alone on: made to match it, or left as they are |
| `why:` | `reason:` | text | kept with the change |

## A track's page

The track editor's line on a track's page: these too (listen mode: these alone).

| Key | Other names | Takes | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `play:` |  | nothing | it, then the rest of its album |
| `queue:` | `enqueue:` | end, next, or nothing | at the end, or next |
| `star:` `-star:` `-star` | `starred:` | yes, no, or nothing | yours (alone: the other way; -star: not starred) |
| `rating:` `-rating:` `-rating` | `rate:` `stars:` | text | yours: 0 to 5 stars, 3.5 too (-rating clears it) |
| `credits:` |  | nothing | opened and scrolled to |
| `notes:` |  | nothing | opened and scrolled to |
| `extras:` |  | nothing | opened and scrolled to |
| `versions:` |  | nothing | opened and scrolled to |
| `merges:` | `merged:` | nothing | opened and scrolled to |
| `tags:` |  | nothing | opened and scrolled to |
| `history:` | `revisions:` | nothing | opened and scrolled to |
| `lyrics:` |  | text, or nothing | opened; an entry's number or language shows it |
| `file:` | `files:` | a number, or nothing | opened; an earlier file's number plays it again (edit mode) |
| `note:` `-note:` |  | text | a new one, one of its notes to edit, or paste |
| `extra:` `-extra:` |  | text | a new one, one of its own to change, or one in the library |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;↳ `kind:` | `type:` | text | vocals, stems, sample… (any word) |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;↳ `file:` | `files:` | a path | a path (Tab completes it), paste, or choose |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;↳ `description:` | `desc:` | text | what it is |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;↳ `source:` |  | text | where it came from |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;↳ `visibility:` | `vis:` `seen:` | text | who sees it: everyone, or groups (Group A, Group B) |
| `og:` `-og:` `-og` | `original:` | text, or nothing | its file is an original file (named so); -og: it isn't |
| `version:` |  | text | edit another version, or a new one by that name (as: renames it) |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;↳ `as:` |  | text | its new name |
| `unmerge:` |  | nothing | the newest merge into it undone |
| `restore:` |  | a number | one of its revisions restored (the list has them, newest first) |
| `sync:` |  | nothing | time the lyrics (the sync popup) |

## Credited as…

The popup (Ctrl+B): a command per artist, several apart by |.

| Key | Other names | Takes | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `artist:` | `from:` | an artist | whose credits change |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;↳ `only:` | `under:` `credits:` | all, own, or one of the artist's names | which of its credits: all, own, or one of its other names |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;↳ `to:` | `instead:` | same, or an artist | credit them to another artist instead (one of to: and as: is needed) |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;↳ `as:` | `alias:` | own, or one of the artist's names | the name they're credited under: own, or an other name (one of to: and as: is needed) |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;↳ `why:` | `reason:` | text | kept with every change |

## A share link

The popup (Ctrl+Shift+L): the keys go together.

| Key | Other names | Takes | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `original:` | `orig:` `og:` | text | the original file, or a lower-quality copy |
| `quality:` | `kbps:` `bitrate:` | text | the copy's bitrate (kbps) |
| `expires:` | `expire:` `expiry:` `exp:` | text | never, 1d, 7d, 30d… |
